gartner-strategic-predictions-2004-001.note: Wikipedia (2006 Lebanon War photographs controversies): Reuters withdrew all 920 Adnan Hajj photos on 7 Aug 2006 for Photoshop manipulation and fired a top photo editor in Jan 2007; political framing (Hezbollywood). Event in window: hit.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2004-003.note: Wikipedia PC market share page: IBM 3rd in 2004, gone after 2005 sale to Lenovo; Gateway page: 8th globally in 2004, acquired by Acer Oct 2007. Fujitsu stayed in the market. 2 exits vs 3 forecast: miss.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2004-004.note: Device classes stayed technologically distinct through 2008 and after (dedicated e-ink Kindle launched Nov 2007, per Wikipedia Amazon Kindle). Event did not happen: miss.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2006-003.note: Pew 2010-02-03 (Social Media and Young Adults): about 1 in 10 online adults blog steadily 2005-2009; 30+ blogging up 7% (Dec 2007) to 11% (2009). Overall contributors did not peak in H1 2007: miss.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2008-004.note: InfoWorld 2012-03-27: Gartner SaaS spending $14.5bn in 2012; Telecompaper: Gartner enterprise application software spending $120.4bn in 2012. Share about 12% vs >=33%: miss.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2008-010.note: Wohlers unit counts (23,265 personal, 6,494 industrial in 2011) not on an opened page (wohlersassociates.com 403; engineering.com gives no units); 3dprintingindustry.com on Wohlers 2013 shows industry revenue growing about 29%/yr, consistent only with a few-fold, not 100x, rise in the installed base. Order of magnitude holds: miss.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2009-009.note: Cited pages do not show the facts the graders rely on: FTC 2014 release gives AT&T throttling from 2011 but no date for ending unlimited sales; AT&T Mobility and Verizon Wikipedia pages give only 2016/2017 reintroduction. No opened source counts how many operators had dropped flat-rate data by 2010 or by 2013-2015, so neither partial nor miss is supported.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2010-01-00.note: TechCrunch 2013-04-08 (Janrain): Facebook 46% of social logins in Q1 2013, about 49% in Q4 2012, ahead of Google 34%. Facebook was the leading social integration hub by 2012: hit.

Grader's global figure (eMarketer about $170bn digital ad spend 2015) could not be opened (404); opened pages give only US IAB $72.5bn (2016) and total all-media global ad spend $536-545bn (Magna/Zenith, Breitbart 2014-12-08). Global internet marketing spend could be about $170-200bn, which is miss or partial (within 25% of $250bn) depending on the figure, and the 'regulated' element is not evidenced either way.
CGAP blog on Global Findex 2014: 62% of adults had an account in 2014, about 2 billion unbanked, so about 3.2bn adults with an account usable for electronic transactions; above 3bn: hit.

ITU ICT Facts and Figures 2013 (PDF opened): more than 2bn mobile-broadband subscriptions and 6.8bn mobile-cellular subscriptions end 2013, vs about 700m fixed broadband; on the dominant device-count reading browser-equipped phones exceeded PCs in use by 2013: hit. PC installed base itself not confirmed on an opened page, but the margin from 6.8bn handsets is wide.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2010-11-00.note: Wikipedia Shamoon: 30,000+ Aramco Windows workstations wiped and fuel-truck loading halted, but exploration and production systems were on isolated networks and unaffected, so whether 'critical infrastructure' was damaged depends on the reading. The 2014 German steel mill case is not cited with any source; evidence too weak for hit or miss.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2011-002.note: Twitter IPO Nov 2013 at about $31bn and Facebook's $19bn WhatsApp deal Feb 2014 (Wikipedia) show rising, not collapsing, social valuations in 2013-2014: miss.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2011-008.note: Census c5700: US imports from China $399.4bn (2011) to $468.5bn (2014), +17%; no evidence of a 20% shift of Asian sourcing to the Americas: miss.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2011-010.note: AWS blog 2014-04-01: 42nd price reduction since 2008, no energy surcharge; leading cloud list prices carried no surcharge: miss.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2012-004.note: No EU directive restricting offshoring or protecting jobs against it was adopted 2012-2016 (the cited EUR-Lex 2013 communication did not load; absence-based). The stated driver did not happen, so the compound claim fails: miss.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2012-010.note: Datamation 2016-02-02 (Gartner): wearables $28.7bn in 2016, smartwatches alone $11.5bn. This is an in-year estimate, not an actual, but it is nearly 3x the $10bn threshold, so the hit holds under the dominant wearables reading.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2013-002.note: Absence of evidence: no major Western manufacturer publicly claimed 3D-printing theft of a mainstream product's IP by 2015 (or within 5 years); known disputes were takedowns of hobby models. Event did not happen: miss.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2013-003.note: FDA 2017 additive-manufacturing guidance covers devices, not bioprinting; no global ban or regulation debate on bioprinting by 2016. Event did not happen: miss.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2013-004.note: FDA additive-manufacturing guidance (draft 2016, final Dec 2017) covers devices and does not prohibit unapproved bioprinting of organs; no such guideline by end 2015 in any developed nation: miss.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2013-007.note: The claim's cause did not occur: graders themselves record mature-economy employment at record highs by 2019 and no unrest attributed to digitization job loss; the basic-income pilots (Wikipedia UBI pilots: Finland cites automation among several motives) answered anticipated, not realized, labor reduction. D16 gives no partial for half of a compound event whose driver failed, as with 2012-004: miss.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2013-008.note: Wikipedia Umbrella Movement: the 2014 Hong Kong occupation demanded electoral reform, not economic redress; Occupy movement page shows only residual actions by 2014. No larger OWS-type economic movement began by end 2014: miss.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2014-003.note: Absence of evidence: no significant disruptive business conceived by an algorithm was reported launched by 2017 or within 5 years after: miss.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2014-004.note: Wikipedia IPO table: Alibaba 2014, $25bn, largest IPO (fits digital market plus logistics); Wikipedia Japan Post: $12bn triple IPO 4 Nov 2015, a legacy postal business, led 2015. Claim held for 2014 but not through 2015: partial.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2014-010.note: Neither partial rationale is supported: A grades 'done by another agent' (wallets, autofill), which is no D16 test; B's cited Google Assistant page mentions Duplex only for phone calls, not form filling, so the claimed 2019 arrival is unconfirmed. gartner-strategic-predictions-2015-004.note: Uber S-1 (SEC, 2019-04-11): 3.9 million Drivers on the platform in Q4 2018, dispatched and rated by algorithm. Above 3 million on the algorithmic-management reading: hit.

gartner-strategic-predictions-2015-007.note: Per-user voice recognition in assistants arrived in 2017 (Google Home voice match, Wikipedia Google Nest), face recognition by an assistant only in 2019, and cross-channel, cross-partner recognition never by 2023. Partly met: partial. Face ID (phone unlock) is not an assistant and does not by itself support the face part.
